purpose: Pre-registration of Cycle-935 predictions BEFORE the composition is computed on the landed 871 machinery. This file carries SHA-256 digests only; no preimage (i.e. no answer) is recorded here. The primary and checker runners recompute each prediction independently, canonicalize it under the sealed scheme, and must reproduce these digests exactly.
holdout_freedom: This file is committed in its own commit BEFORE scripts/frontier_cycle935_bridge_cashed_2026_07_28.py and its checker exist in the tree. Git history is the build log: the seal commit precedes the computation commits, so no prediction can have been fitted to a computed result.

prediction_semantics.P1_composed_free_dimension: free dimension of the source-action bridge AFTER composing the Cycle-871 structure theorem with the registered scale-reference primitive
prediction_semantics.P2_reduction_from_registration: 871 free dimension MINUS composed free dimension (how much the registration bought)
prediction_semantics.P3_observables_separating_gauge_points: count of in-scope observables (values, pairwise differences, ratios) that separate the pre-registration gauge point from the post-registration gauge point
prediction_semantics.P4_deviation_from_871_rows: total value-for-value deviation of replayed Cycle-871 receipt rows (dimension tables, ablation, stabilizer group, obligation map) from the pinned 871 bytes
prediction_semantics.P5_scope_verdict: verdict token of the supply-scope test, decided by the scale-reference primitive's OWN text
prediction_semantics.P6_gnewton_derives: whether the G_Newton/SI-normalization clause (871 Result 3, classified EQUIVALENT to the bridge) DERIVES once the scale reference is registered

honesty: The sealed values were fixed from the reading of the primitive's own text and the 871 note, before any Cycle-935 computation was written or run. If a computation contradicts a seal, the seal FAILS loudly and the contradiction is the finding; seals are never rewritten to match results.
